**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `c2b15b8`: all 11 files reviewed.

2 finding(s): 2 to fix; 2 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

This PR removes the hand-kept documentation indexes: the changelog, the ADR table and the audit-plan status tables. It also switches the Desktop App and Backlog sidebar groups to autogenerate. Nothing still links to the deleted `/changelog` page except older plans, which are history.

I found two problems, neither blocking:
- **Committed build cache:** the PR adds two Swift Package Manager cache files under `.build/`. The repository has no Swift package and doesn't ignore `.build/`, so they look like local build output staged by accident.
- **Sidebar rule in `CLAUDE.md` is not quite true:** it now says every content folder autogenerates, but the Stack and Authentication groups are still listed by hand in `astro.config.mjs`. A new page in either folder would not show up in the sidebar.

> ℹ️ No blocking issues. Two stray build files and one leftover status line are worth fixing before merge. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the one commit that removes the docs site's hand-kept indexes and moves the last two manual sidebar groups to autogeneration. - **Sidebar:** Desktop App and Backlog now use `autogenerate`, and the Changelog group is gone. Neither folder has subdirectories or a `backlog/index*` page, so nothing is lost. - **ADR index:** the table is replaced by a pointer to the generated sidebar. - **Audit fix plans:** `00-index.md` loses its status line, its batch tables, the Shipped table and the coverage check. Shipping status now lives in Linear. - **Changelog removal:** `changelog.mdx` is deleted, and the `briefings/index.md` link to it is replaced. The changelog template and step 7 are removed from the `feature-docs` skill and `/save-feature`. No link to `/changelog` remains outside the historical `plans/`. - **`CLAUDE.md`:** the Sidebar rule now says every folder autogenerates. ### ℹ️ `report.md` still has a hand-kept status line and a mapping claim the index no longer backs The PR removes "12 of 36 plans shipped" from `00-index.md`. But `audits/2026-10-15/report.md:10` still says **"🟡 Fixes in progress — 11 of 36 plans shipped"**. That count is the same kind of hand-kept status, and it is already out of date. Line 12 still says "Every finding maps to one implementation plan: [fix plans index]", but the index no longer maps findings to plans: the coverage check and the per-plan `Closes` columns are gone. Both lines are outside the diff, so I couldn't comment on them inline.
Technical details ````markdown # Leftover hand-kept status in the audit report ## Affected sites - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/audits/2026-10-15/report.md:10 — "Fixes in progress — 11 of 36 plans shipped" is a hand-kept count; it is stale (the removed index said 12) and contradicts the PR's goal - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/audits/2026-10-15/report.md:12 — "Every finding maps to one implementation plan: [fix plans index]" — the index no longer holds the finding → plan mapping ## Required outcome - No hand-kept shipped count in report.md; status points to Linear (NIW2-381 to NIW2-422) like line 96 now does - The line 12 sentence describes where the finding → plan mapping actually lives (each plan page lists the findings it retires) ````
